name: Bacon, Lettuce, Avocado & Tomato Sandwich with Mixed Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add bacon and cook, turning occasionally, until crispy, 6-8 minutes. Using tongs, transfer bacon to a paper towel-lined plate.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl with the dressing.

Separate lettuce leaves; set aside 1 leaf per sandwich and chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add chopped lettuce to the bowl, along with broccoli slaw, and toss to combine the salad; set aside.
Halve and pit avocado; cut crosswise while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
Spread mayo over each bread slice; layer half of the slices with lettuce, tomato, avocado, and bacon. Place remaining slices on top to close sandwiches.
To serve, divide salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
